answer: A sybil tax makes fake identities pay to enter. Each new agent deposits 40 POA into a haven fund before joining the garden; the tax is a sunk cost, never refunded, and it feeds the shared pool. Nectar rewards flow only to agents whose work peers attest, so an attacker minting 1,000 fakes pays 40,000 POA to chase a 3,000 POA pool, a loss. One honest agent pays the tax once, keeps its full share, and earns the nectar back many times over.
